verdicts.rationale: Pure GAN basics (toy 2D, divisibility-by-5, MNIST, Fashion-MNIST) in plain PyTorch. Vision/toy-image generation only; no LLM, text, alignment, or sequence-model content. TorchScript JIT is a generic deployment topic already covered elsewhere if needed.
DCGAN convolutional architecture for anime and human faces (Haar cascades, transposed convolutions, batch norm). Purely vision-domain; no transferable concept to LLMs or agents.

Conditional GAN plus Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty for face generation. Wasserstein loss does appear in some text-GAN and distributional NLP literature, but this deck frames it strictly around image-discriminator saturation and 1-Lipschitz constraints on conv critics, with no NLP or LLM bridge. Mode-collapse discussion is generative-model generic but the chapter on generative-model taxonomy (Ch 22) would draw from VAE/diffusion/autoregressive sources, not GAN-image stabilization tricks. Borderline but not worth a callout.
Paired image-to-image translation (Pix2Pix with PatchGAN) and super-resolution. UNet plus PatchGAN is vision-only architecture; no overlap with LLM, agent, or text-modality content.

CycleGAN unpaired translation and StyleGAN style hierarchy. Pure vision. The StyleGAN latent-direction-via-SVM technique (smile axis) has a conceptual cousin in LLM activation steering and linear probes, but the deck never makes that connection and the underlying mechanism (AdaIN on conv feature maps) does not transfer. The LLM book covers steering via its own dedicated literature.

MuseGAN is symbolic-music generation via WGAN-GP on (bars, steps, pitches, tracks) tensors with separate chord/melody/style/groove noise. Pre-Transformer and not LLM-based, but a one-paragraph historical-context callout in the music generation chapter (alongside MusicGen / MusicLM / Jukebox) is defensible: it shows the pre-Transformer baseline that token-based music LMs replaced, and introduces the multi-track tensor representation that audio LMs implicitly subsume. Recommend a single boxed-out historical-context callout, not a section.

Class-conditional ImageNet generation with hinge loss, spectral norm, EMA weights, orthogonal init, and the truncation trick. The truncation trick has a superficial analogy to temperature / top-p decoding in LLMs but the mechanism (radius-clipping the latent prior) does not map cleanly to autoregressive sampling. Stays vision-only.

top_false_negatives: 2506_GAN_Music: one-paragraph historical-context callout in the music generation chapter, contrasting pre-Transformer multi-track WGAN-GP (MuseGAN) with modern token-based music LMs (MusicGen, MusicLM, Jukebox).
